mission: Build the highest-reuse Brain-native residual chart primitive: calibrated y-value query from a uniquely legend-bound colored raster curve at a requested x value.
rationale: Public Chartography scope explicitly includes multiple curve-read families such as Kaplan-Meier, growth charts, and Bode plots.
This primitive composes already-verified positioned OCR axis binding, legend-to-color binding, and raster polyline geometry.
It grants no domain semantics; later adapters must prove family-specific interpretation separately.
